scientific_question: Does a fully frozen official SpeechBrain ECAPA-TDNN representation provide useful, leak-free error diversity relative to the locked CAM++ Fold0 known-first/OOD control?
hypothesis: ECAPA's SE-Res2 blocks, hierarchical feature aggregation, and channel-dependent attentive statistics pooling will encode complementary speaker cues; a fixed 50/50 probability average may rescue CAM++ errors without degrading Known Accuracy or OOD-F1.

primary_sources.title: ECAPA-TDNN: Emphasized Channel Attention, Propagation and Aggregation in TDNN Based Speaker Verification

intervention.single_scientific_change: Replace the CAM++ representation with the pinned official SpeechBrain ECAPA representation and keep the ECAPA encoder fully frozen while training only the existing known-speaker and binary-OOD heads.
intervention.head: 446-way ArcFace plus independent binary OOD
intervention.decision: raw probability-average over eight evaluation windows followed by direct argmax
intervention.only_ensemble: fixed 50/50 probability average with locked CAM++ control Fold0

promotion: Passing Fold0 permits a separately preregistered Fold1/Fold2 validation only; it does not authorize a submission or tuned blend.
